subject.title: RFC: add local adaptive-refresh replay tooling

question: Should CodexBar permanently own and ship AdaptiveReplayCLI and its package-internal replay analysis modules as a supported developer tool?
rationale: Implementation quality is no longer the blocker; VISION.md reserves this new product, package architecture, and ongoing maintenance surface for explicit owner acceptance.

options.title: Accept the upstream tool
options.body: Merge the input-only CLI and shared core as supported evidence infrastructure without approving trace collection or production-policy changes.

options.title: Keep replay tooling external
options.body: Decline the executable and analysis modules while retaining the existing adaptive runtime implementation and decision record.

recommendation.title: Accept the upstream tool
recommendation.body: Merge the input-only CLI and shared core as supported evidence infrastructure without approving trace collection or production-policy changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner reviewed the underlying adaptive-refresh implementation and owns the explicit VISION.md product-sign-off gate.
